 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order
Exemption allowed subject to all just exceptions.

1. This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.55/2016 under sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Vijay Vihar on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes vide Compromise Deed dated 4th July, 2018 which is on record of this Court.

2. As per the FIR, petitioner no.1 was married to respondent no.2 on 18th October, 2013 but due to disputes and differences, the marriage was dissolved by mutual consent vide decree of divorce dated 25th January, 2019.
No child was born out of this wedlock.
3. While petitioner no.2 is stated to have expired on 11th February, 2023, petitioner No.1 is present in the Court and is duly identified by the IO.

However, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he has been informed that respondent no.2 is not available today due to some personal reasons and therefore, requests for a short accommodation.
The IO shall notify the respondent no.2 to appear before this Court on the next date, either personally or through her counsel or through VC.
6. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.

ANISH DAYAL, J FEBRUARY 16, 2023/sm Santosh Kumar & Anr vs The State Govt Of Nct Of Delhi & Anr on 16 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154061018/
